whatsappMessage:
Hi Bake n Bite bliss team,

I noticed your bakery has stellar 4.9★ reviews from 100+ customers near Kurthoul, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for instant cake and custom pastry orders.

Maine aapke bakery ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp cake booking, birthday/anniversary menu, aur delivery details integrate ki hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/bakenbitebliss

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Bake n Bite bliss team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp cake ordering and mobile-first menu display for customers near Kurthoul, Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact cake varieties, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
